items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: He played with us too already. But he didn't play saxophone then, he was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: He passed. He passed. He passed. He was hit by a car, hit one driver. Came back from California to visit his brothers and got one of them. He was a pastor. Palleter you're talking about.
Willie I used to call him. He played with us too already. But he didn't play saxophone then, he was playing clarinet. With who? Which band? With the Silver Leaf band. There's a band right there.
Oh yeah. Did he play before Dutri?
